v29_inbox_target.description: CYC4-003. The bundle the agent starts through the inbox. Expect BUNDLE_START with channel=inbox and caller the opener, then its mark, and an INBOX action=dispatched record for the request.

v29_bundle_opens_inbox.description: CYC4-003. A bundle may not open the inbox. Run it from chat while the inbox is closed. Expect INBOX action=refused reason=fromBundle, an ERROR for the open, no status.json, and the end mark.
